# MSIX mailto dispatch uses the same compose argument as the NSIS association

The MSIX manifest forwards a quoted mailto URL with -osint -compose, matching the NSIS mailto registration. The command-line consumer handles compose and opens the composer after main-window/account setup; compose startup recognizes a mailto string and obtains mailto compose parameters. This is source-level dispatch evidence only, not proof of Windows package registration or a fix for other protocols. No Windows execution or package test.

Scope: windows-mailto-association.
